title: Fundamental Accounting Concepts (FAC)
description: Universal accounting substrate: Charlie Hoffman's Fundamental Accounting Concepts (Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Revenues, Expenses, Income, Cash Flow) plus their presentation hierarchies, calculation identities, verification rules, and the trait-vocabulary metamodel that classifies elements along universal axes (elementsOfFinancialStatements, liquidity, activityType, recordedValue, …). Designed to be the shared foundation that every accounting reporting framework (rs-gaap, rs-ifrs, rs-call-report, rs-statutory, rs-irs, rs-ferc) inherits via depends_on. FAC concepts forked from Seattle Method; metamodel forked from FASB us-gaap 2026 metamodel publication; both now maintained natively as JSON-LD.
